name: Personal Song
description: Sing yourself a little song when you head into battle. When attacking gain Jubilant, Peaceful, and Battle song buffs in that order.

name: Fae Companion
description: A fae companion that provides healing when you are low on life.

name: Sugar Rush
description: Damaging an enemy has a chance to drop candy that increases attack and movement speed or healing.

name: Prickly Persona
description: Enemy attacks have a chance to cover you in thistles, returning damage to attackers.

name: Research Net
description: Critical hits have a chance to root targets in place for a short duration.

name: Burning Zealot
description: Physical damage to enemies has a chance to apply fire to them.

name: Sparkle Grenade
description: Critical hits to enemies can spawn a shiny bomb that deals damage and stuns enemies.

name: Rain Destruction
description: Damage dealt to enemies while airborne is increased.

name: Glacial Ward
description: Chance on damage received to activate a shield. Lasts 5s. While active, movement speed, magic damage, and attack speed are increased. Damage received greater than 50% of your HP is absorbed.

name: Mounted Cavalry
description: Increased movement speed while riding ground based mounts. At low health gain a damage reduction shield for a short time.

name: Sorta Crazy
description: Chance during combat to transform and receive some of the power of the Lunar Lancer.

name: Assassinate
description: Chance to deal bonus damage to enemies with less than 20% health.

name: Naval Gunfire
description: Damaging an enemy has a chance to call a cannon ball from the sky.

name: Searing Light
description: Magic attacks to enemies can activate Searing Light, a damage over time effect.

name: Phoenix Fire
description: Basic attacks have a chance to explode dealing damage to enemies and applying a damage over time effect that restores energy.
